verdict.rationale: Missive documents an official MCP server that external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can connect to. Through it they can act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with user-chosen permissions, including summarizing the inbox, drafting replies, and triaging new conversations. A REST API with conversations and drafts endpoints backs this up. The 'send' step is never explicitly documented: the evidence only covers creating and acting on drafts, so a fully end-to-end send by the agent is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an external agent can send email via MCP or the API, details of the MCP server's tool set and permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
